Name: Botany of Teyvat
Author: oclarina
Description:
Botany of Teyvat is a mod for Stardew Valley that adds various collectible plants from Genshin Impact to your roster of growable crops. At current it adds 54 crops and 5 trees, each with its own custom artwork, as well as eight bush crops, which can act like vanilla's tea bushes if you also have LeFauxMatt's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]custom bush mod[/url]. Most of the seeds can be bought at Pierre's, but some come from alternative sources.

For more information on where to obtain seeds, growth times, prices, and gift tastes, please refer to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3374]Player's Guide[/url]!

If you want even more Genshin in your Stardew, also check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38335]Mycology and More of Teyvat[/url]!

[u][img]https://i.imgur.com/xqpbFgl.png[/img]
[/u][b][color=#444444]Config Options[/color]
"Redundant Crops"[/b] - Chooses the behavior for crops that might have similar items in other mods.
[list]
[*]Removed: Removes the Botany of Teyvat version of the item entirely[/*]
[*]Specific: Gives the Botany of Teyvat items more specific names, e.g. "Liyue Winter Radish"[/*]
[*]Generic (Default): Gives the Botany of Teyvat items a simplified and generic name, e.g. "Daikon Radish"[/*]
[/list][b]"Exclude from Perfection" [/b]- Decides whether items from Botany of Teyvat should be included in the shipping collection for perfection. Check true to include, and uncheck to exclude. Included by default.
[b]"Enable Bush Crops" [/b]- Determines whether the six bush crops should act like tea bushes or like regular crops. Only does anything if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]custom bush[/url] is installed.
[list]
[*]true: The six bush crops will act like tea bushes.[/*]
[*]false: The six bush crops will act like regular, regrowable crops.[/*]
[/list][b]
[u][img]https://i.imgur.com/Y3ep5ym.png[/img][/u]
[color=#444444][size=2]Compatibility[/size][/color]
[/b]No known incompatibilities! If anything does come up, [b]please[/b] do tell me, so that I can try to figure it out.

All credit where it's due to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Obi1005]Obi[/url], who not only has worked with me to provide Traditional and Simplified Mandarin translations, but also put together the header images for the mod page!
And a special thank you to all my friends, who despite not really being into Genshin, still encouraged me along the way.
